description: Agents wrote into the read-only primary clone through relative paths at least six times in one session (workers on the digest, durations and CedarDB items, the SQLGlot worker, and the mirror worker twice); the mirror worker also reported its own worktree being reset twice with lost edits. Nothing flagged the dirty primary: the existing guard fires only from make pr-open and the done item agent-write-preflight-commit-path-gap covers only commits. The stray edits were found by manual git status and restored by hand. Work: add a cheap check that fails when the primary clone has uncommitted tracked changes (run from agent-write-preflight, pr-preflight and ideally a documented session-start/end command), name the changed paths, and document using absolute worktree paths in the worker instructions. Investigate the cause of the worktree resets. Guardrail: never auto-discard files; report only.
